title: andrographis atropurpurea
intro: Andrographis atropurpurea, commonly known as Kalmegh, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This herb has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Andrographis atropurpurea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its ability to protect against infections and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include andrographolide, neoandrographolide, and 14-deoxyandrographolide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
